segments.text: MDVR office testing steps.
One, testing essential items, please prepare these things before testing.
To open MDVR, open the device with the key.
Three, loading card.
Insert the SD card, hard drive, or SIM card into the machine.
After installing the card, close and lock for accessory connection.
Find camera connection cable, connect camera.
Find the monitoring screen connection cable, connect monitoring,
connect 4G antenna, connect GPS antenna.
5 power on, use power supply equipment to power MDVR,
voltage 8 to 36 volt.
Connect the black wire to the power ground wire.
Connect the red and yellow wires to the live wire.
Connect the power cord to the MDVR.
If other power supply equipment is used,
this connection is also possible.
Six, debugging.
In the remote control at the IR of MDVR,
press enter on the remote control,
according to the steps displayed on the screen.
According to your SIM card configuration here.
Finally, press give directional key.
Press continuously for three times.
This content appears successfully launched.
